arms.completion: B: Qwen with Jev completion checks
arms.business-qwen: C: business-mode source plan with Qwen choices and Jev completion checks
arms.business-jev: D: identical plan with Jev choices/predicates, constrained Qwen fallback, Jev completion checks

full.arm_order: cyclic Latin rotation; equal positions within each domain

preparation.input: Only SOP text, tool schemas and input field names; no task values or labels
preparation.cache: Source-only frozen manifest; same source artifacts C/D; runtime require_cached enabled by driver
preparation.failures: Retain rejected/unsupported/error plans and every provider attempt; ordinary execution fallback without task-time recompilation
preparation.cost: Preparation paid once physically, same full relevant cost for either compiled deployment. Deduplicate by manifest identity and domain when combining pilot/full schedules. Never split P between C/D.
preparation.latency: Separate source preparation wall time from warm case execution; runtime cache loading remains in case latency

routing.completion_eligibility: Same existing eligibility for B/C/D; planning business mode cannot suppress it

accounting.cost_policy: Documented usage list rates; cached input at full input price. Actual cached-input billing unverified. Count every LLM and Jev attempt including fallback and errors.

limits: Reused holdout is not new confirmation
Strict output scoring is not full prose SOP compliance
Zero supported business decisions is a valid domain result
Latency includes cross-case and cross-domain provider contention
Confidence threshold is not a measured accuracy guarantee
